name: Asenath
bio: Asenath is the daughter of Potipherah, priest of On, whom Pharaoh gave to Joseph as his wife (Genesis 41:45). She bore Joseph two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim, who were later blessed by Jacob on his deathbed and adopted as tribes of Israel — meaning that although Asenath herself was Egyptian, her descendants became fully woven into the inheritance and legacy of the twelve tribes of Israel (Genesis 41:50-52; 48:5).
